notes.title: Change Game Title
notes.notes:
Hi everyone.
We are Braineart.
We inform you that we decided to change our game name from "Uninvited" to "The little vampir".
A few weeks ago, we heard our game name is similar to game title of company Zojoi. 
And we discussed this problem with Zojoi.

It's not easy to decide to change the game title, because it demands many things to change.
But when we considered other problems, we thought it is right.

Anyway, Now, our title is "The little vampir"!

notes.title: Postpone the release date
notes.notes:
Hi, guys. It's Braineart.
We are very sorry to announce that the game's release date is postponed.
In the process of fixing bugs, we found some fatal bugs that affect the game play.
For a better game, we decided to postpone the date.
The changed date is 1 July (30 June in Korean time)

Again, We are very sorry.
Thanks.
